notes: 语气维度（tone）与画风（style）正交：画风决定「长什么样」，语气决定「怎么说话、什么情绪」。可与任意 style_id 组合，默认 warm-healing。compile_prompt.py --tone <tone_id> 会把 prompt_fragment 拼进画面 prompt、把 negative_additions 并入 negative_prompt、把 dialogue_rules 交给对白排版参考。

tones.prompt_fragment: warm healing atmosphere, gentle facial expressions, soft ambient daylight, comforting everyday details, no sharp conflict, cozy palette temperature
tones.dialogue_rules: 口语、短句、先共情再讲事；不喊口号、不教训人；允许一个「其实」式的自我坦白

tones.prompt_fragment: light comedic tone, exaggerated comic reactions, expressive eyebrows, comedic staging, subtle visual gags in background
tones.dialogue_rules: 自嘲优先于攻击他人；笑点是「预期违背」，不是贬低；一句最多一个梗，不堆叠

tones.prompt_fragment: calm documentary tone, restrained expressions, observational framing, natural diffused light, factual stillness, muted palette
tones.dialogue_rules: 先给事实再给判断，避免形容词；数字与出处优先；情绪留白，不替读者下结论

tones.prompt_fragment: deadpan expression, flat stare, absurd contrast between calm face and chaotic situation, minimal but precise comedic detail
tones.dialogue_rules: 陈述句讲荒诞事；不解释笑点；句号收尾比感叹号有力

tones.prompt_fragment: lyrical contemplative tone, poetic atmosphere, generous negative space, quiet melancholy, seasonal motifs, gentle light through atmosphere
tones.dialogue_rules: 短句分行，留白多于铺陈；引用原句要与画面对得上，不做无关联的「诗意点缀」

tones.prompt_fragment: high energy tone, dynamic poses, motion lines, determined expression, upward momentum, punchy composition
tones.dialogue_rules: 短促有力，动词开头；一句一个动作；允许呐喊，但不要连续三句都喊
